access_graduate.title: Access Bank careers: Entry Level Training Programme steps
facts: Stages: Application; Online Assessments; Physical Assessments; Document & Eligibility Verification; Interview stages (panel and top management); Medical Fitness Assessment; 6-month training period.
access_graduate.caveat: Stage titles read from the official page; the page's descriptions were placeholders. Training school name not verified.

gtb_graduate.title: GTBank careers: Entry Level Programme
facts: Stages: online assessment; informal HR chat with documents (possibly an essay); competency-based panel interview; final interview with an executive; four-month Entry Level Programme.
gtb_graduate.caveat: Official page could not be loaded directly; sequence taken from summaries of that page. Four-month length medium confidence.
